title: SEC Major Filings Feed
description: Optional credential: SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT overrides the default SEC fair-access User-Agent. SEC EDGAR doesn't issue API keys - it just wants a reachable email in the User-Agent string. Leave it unset and the script uses the SpeakesQuery default; set it (e.g. "your.name@example.com") to supply your own contact. Monitors recent SEC filings (Form 4 insider trades, 8-K material events, 10-K annual reports, 10-Q quarterly reports) from the top 15 most-followed companies (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, TSLA, BRK, JPM, V, JNJ, WMT, PG, MA, UNH). Insider Form 4 filings are the most actionable - clusters of insider buying have historically beaten the market by 7-10% annually. 8-K filings often contain market-moving news before it hits headlines.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

contact = (CREDENTIALS.get('SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT') or '').strip()
if not contact or '@' not in contact:
    # SEC EDGAR's fair-access policy accepts any User-Agent that contains
    # a reachable email - it is NOT an API key / authentication token. Fall
    # back to the project default so scheduled SEC jobs run out of the box;
    # users can override by setting SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT in Settings → Credentials.
    contact = 'SpeakesQuery EDGAR (noreply@speakesquery.local)'
HEADERS = {'User-Agent': contact}
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

# Top 15 companies by market cap with their CIKs (zero-padded to 10 digits)
COMPANIES = [
    ('AAPL', '0000320193'), ('MSFT', '0000789019'), ('GOOGL', '0001652044'),
    ('AMZN', '0001018724'), ('NVDA', '0001045810'), ('META', '0001326801'),
    ('TSLA', '0001318605'), ('BRK-B', '0001067983'), ('JPM', '0000019617'),
    ('V', '0001403161'), ('JNJ', '0000200406'), ('WMT', '0000104169'),
    ('PG', '0000080424'), ('MA', '0001141391'), ('UNH', '0000731766'),
]

TARGET_FORMS = ['4', '4/A', '8-K', '8-K/A', '10-K', '10-K/A', '10-Q', '10-Q/A', '13F-HR']

rows = []
for idx in range(len(COMPANIES)):
    ticker = COMPANIES[idx][0]
    cik = COMPANIES[idx][1]

    resp = requests.get(
        f'https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{cik}.json',
        headers=HEADERS,
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()

    company_name = data.get('name', ticker)
    recent = data.get('filings', {}).get('recent', {})
    forms = recent.get('form', [])
    dates = recent.get('filingDate', [])
    report_dates = recent.get('reportDate', [])
    accessions = recent.get('accessionNumber', [])
    descriptions = recent.get('primaryDocDescription', [])
    items_list = recent.get('items', [])

    count = min(len(forms), 50)
    for i in range(count):
        form = forms[i]
        if form not in TARGET_FORMS:
            continue

        filing_date = dates[i] if i < len(dates) else ''
        report_date = report_dates[i] if i < len(report_dates) else ''
        accession = accessions[i] if i < len(accessions) else ''
        desc = descriptions[i] if i < len(descriptions) else ''
        items = items_list[i] if i < len(items_list) else ''

        # Classify filing importance
        if form in ('4', '4/A'):
            filing_type = 'INSIDER_TRADE'
            importance = 'HIGH'
        elif form in ('8-K', '8-K/A'):
            filing_type = 'MATERIAL_EVENT'
            importance = 'HIGH'
        elif form in ('10-K', '10-K/A'):
            filing_type = 'ANNUAL_REPORT'
            importance = 'MEDIUM'
        elif form in ('10-Q', '10-Q/A'):
            filing_type = 'QUARTERLY_REPORT'
            importance = 'MEDIUM'
        elif form == '13F-HR':
            filing_type = 'INSTITUTIONAL_HOLDINGS'
            importance = 'MEDIUM'
        else:
            filing_type = 'OTHER'
            importance = 'LOW'

        rows.append({
            'ticker': ticker,
            'company_name': company_name,
            'cik': cik,
            'form_type': form,
            'filing_type': filing_type,
            'filing_date': filing_date,
            'report_date': report_date,
            'accession_number': accession,
            'description': desc,
            'items': items,
            'importance': importance,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

    time.sleep(0.15)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('filing_date', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
